title: Single model or AI team — which answers priority questions better?
summary: 21 high-priority questions about one complex HIV/TB patient (Aloice), comparing two single models (Gemma 2B and 26B) with three AI-team configurations.
takeaway: The 26B single model led on accuracy (9.1/10); the AI team's Advanced tier led on completeness (8.4/10). No unsafe answers in this run.
